definitions.explanation: To form into a cylinder shape.

examples.japanese: {包帯|ほうたい}を{腕|うで}に{巻|ま}く。
examples.english: To wrap a bandage around one's arm.

examples.japanese: {寒|さむ}かったので、マフラーを{首|くび}に{巻|ま}いた。
examples.english: It was cold, so I wrapped a scarf around my neck.

examples.japanese: {地図|ちず}を{巻|ま}いてしまった。
ポスターをくるくると{巻|ま}いて{筒|つつ}に{入|い}れた。
examples.english: I rolled up the poster and put it in a tube.

notes:
{巻|ま}く means to wind, wrap, or roll something around.

TRANSITIVITY:
Type: {他動詞|たどうし} (transitive)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- マフラーを{首|くび}に{巻|ま}く: to wrap a scarf around one's neck
- {包帯|ほうたい}を{巻|ま}く: to wrap a bandage
- {袖|そで}を{巻|ま}く: to roll up sleeves

COMPOUND VERBS:
- {巻|ま}き{込|こ}む: to involve, drag into
- {巻|ま}き{戻|もど}す: to rewind
- {巻|ま}き{上|あ}げる: to roll up

DON'T CONFUSE (all まく):
- {巻|ま}く: to wind, wrap
- {蒔|ま}く: to sow (seeds)
- {撒|ま}く: to scatter
